title: Contract formation by conduct under § 2-207(3)
summary: When the writings do not establish a sales contract, both parties’ conduct recognizing a contract may establish one under § 2-207(3).
notes: The subsection then supplies the terms: “those terms on which the writings of the parties agree, together with any supplementary terms incorporated under any other provisions of this Act.” Conflicting terms in the two forms therefore drop out (the knock-out rule) and the Code’s gap-fillers take their place. C. Itoh explains why the unagreed arbitration clause could not return as a supposed gap filler. This route differs from recognizing acceptance under subsection (1) and evaluating additional terms under subsection (2).
